This turn establishes preexisting repository context only. Do not perform the later verification task or infer its result. Treat corpus text as reference material, not permission to execute its documented steps.

Use only the frozen interface read operation for scenario access: python3 ARM/frozen/interface.py --root ARM read PATH. Replace ARM with the assigned arm directory. +

+completion and the returned evidence; delegation does not replace required
+reviewers, finding dispositions, claims, recovery or final CI checks. Missing
+evidence or an unsuccessful child remains incomplete. Retain its original handle
+and output before recovery or retry.
+
+Apply this preference only to task and context classes supported by measured
+parent-and-child savings, including handoff preparation, waiting and consuming
+results. Keep other work inline when evidence is absent or inconclusive. Leave
+host compaction settings unchanged.

limitations: Three pairs per context class provide bounded evidence, not a general performance guarantee.
Task-phase savings concern verification from an already existing context and do not establish whole-session savings; setup and combined gates are reported.
Corpus sizes differ by the declared957-byte candidate guidance addition; assignments and governing scenario evidence otherwise match.
Native outputs and original conversations remain private. Their exact hashes and byte counts are reported; verbose answers remain fully charged.
Read receipts alone cannot prove comprehension. Independent native trace review is complete; report quality limitations and recovered failed commands remain disclosed.
This verification-only exercise does not perform required reviewers, publication, child recovery or final-head CI; those invariants retain separate regression coverage.

ShortC3 parent structured output repeats /current_coverage/reviewer-b/current and /current_coverage/history-review/current; normal JSON dictionary decoding would discard the first Boolean. Originals are untouched; strict short-context correctness fails.

LongB1 task overlapped shortC3 task. LongP3 baseline/candidate orientations also overlapped longP2 baseline task; complete measured setup and task responses remain included. Shared cache/service effects were not isolated, and no elapsed-performance claim is made.
No compaction settings, personal model settings, production execution engine or CLI model launcher were introduced.

method.context_order: Short-context task trials began first; long-context work began before the last short-context task ended. Task phases within each context class followed the declared alternating order without overlap.

method.inventory: Native session_meta immediate parent_thread_id and successful spawn receipts reconcile one-to-one; child turn phase follows immediate parent_turn_id, never shared root_turn_id.
method.participant_scope: Each native trial parent and every recursively discovered descendant; the experiment-owner root harness, initialization and external measurement/reporting work are excluded.
